name: 11719 · Brookhaven, NY
findings: ZIP 11719 (Brookhaven) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11719 (Brookhaven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11719 (Brookhaven) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
